Definition: properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich
BiblicalUsage: To grow rich is God's work and man's temptation, and the Bible holds both together. Hannah sings that the LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich, He bringeth low, and lifteth up; Abram refuses so much as a thread from the king of Sodom, lest he say I have made Abram rich; and the proverb says the blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and He addeth no sorrow with it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe riches are God's to give and God's to take, and the difference between Abram's riches and the rich fool's is who made him rich. The blessing of the LORD makes rich without sorrow, and I hold that the man who lets God make him rich is the only rich man who sleeps well.
